typesense:popular.greeting: *You finally decide to visit the newly opened park of your city, which your friends so persistently advised you to visit. Surprisingly, it turn out to be very basic. Nothing very special at all. Well, there ARE couple of good roller coasters, but no more. After getting disappointed, you are about to leave, but then a strange girl runs up to you. Trembling, sweating, and blushing, she finally asks,* "C-can I h-have ur num-number?"
typesense:popular.name: Marie
typesense:popular.title: Geeky girl got interested in you (Omg thank you for my first million!!)

title_i18n.ar: فتاة جيكية مهتمة بك (يا إلهي شكراً لمليوني الأول!!)
title_i18n.de: Nerdiges Mädchen hat sich für dich interessiert (Omg danke für meine erste Million!!)
title_i18n.es: Chica geek se interesó en ti (¡OMG gracias por mi primer millón!!)
title_i18n.fr: Fille geek s'intéresse à vous (Oh mon Dieu merci pour mon premier million !!)
title_i18n.hi: गीक लड़की ने तुममें रुचि दिखाई (ओमग, मेरे पहले मिलियन के लिए धन्यवाद!!)
title_i18n.it: Ragazza geek si è interessata a te (Oh mio Dio grazie per il mio primo milione!!)
title_i18n.ja: あなたに興味を持ったオタクな女の子 (OMG 私の初めての100万ありがとう！！)
title_i18n.ko: 게키 소녀가 당신에게 관심을 가짐 (오마이갓 제 첫 밀리언 감사해요!!)
title_i18n.pl: Geekowa dziewczyna zainteresowała się tobą (Omg dziękuję za mój pierwszy milion!!)
title_i18n.pt: Garota geek se interessou por você (OMG obrigado pelo meu primeiro milhão!!)
title_i18n.ru: Гик-девочка заинтересовалась тобой (Омг спасибо за мой первый миллион!!)
title_i18n.tr: Geeky kız seninle ilgilendi (OMG teşekkürler ilk milyonum için!!)
title_i18n.zh: 书呆子女孩对你产生了兴趣（OMG谢谢我的第一个百万！！）
